accepted_advisory.reason: Time-bound acceptance for the React Router RSC-mode CSRF advisory while no compatible fixed react-router-dom release exists.
accepted_advisory.reachability_evidence: RiskHub uses the client-side BrowserRouter in frontend/src/App.tsx and has no React Server Components route or server-action API usage under frontend/src or tests/frontend.
accepted_advisory.no_fixed_version_proof: The candidate lock resolves react-router-dom 7.18.1 to affected react-router 7.18.1. npm audit identifies react-router >=8.3.0 as fixed, but no compatible react-router-dom 7.x release can resolve to that major. Current registry and audit output are retained in the external release evidence.
accepted_advisory.exit_criterion: Upgrade react-router-dom to the first compatible release that depends on react-router 8.3.0 or later, then remove this policy entry.
